title: Downhill Fireline Construction Checklist
cross_references: Common Denominators of Fire Behavior on Tragedy Fires

evidence.source_text: Downhill fireline construction is hazardous in steep terrain, fast-burning fuels, or rapidly changing weather. It should not be attempted unless there is no tactical alternative.

nodes.text: Discuss assignments with crew supervisor(s) and fireline overhead prior to committing crew(s). Responsible overhead individual stays with job until completed (TFLD or ICT4 qualified at minimum)

evidence.source_text: 1. Discuss assignments with crew supervisor(s) and fireline overhead prior to committing crew(s). Responsible overhead individual stays with job until completed (Task Force Leader [TFLD] or Incident Commander Type 4 [ICT4] qualified at minimum).

nodes.text: Decision is made after proposed fireline has been scouted by supervisor(s) of involved crew(s)

evidence.source_text: 2. Decision is made after proposed fireline has been scouted by supervisor(s) of involved crew(s).

nodes.text: Coordinate LCES for all personnel involved

evidence.source_text: 3. Coordinate LCES for all personnel involved.

nodes.text: Crew supervisor(s) in direct contact with lookout who can see the fire

evidence.source_text:  Crew supervisor(s) in direct contact with lookout who can see the fire.

nodes.text: Ensure rapid access to safety zone(s) in case fire crosses below crew(s)

evidence.source_text:  Rapid access to safety zone(s) in case fire crosses below crew(s).

nodes.text: Use direct attack whenever possible. If not possible, complete fireline between anchor points before being fired out

evidence.source_text: 4. Use direct attack whenever possible. If not possible, the fireline should be completed between anchor points before being fired out.

nodes.text: Ensure fireline will not lie in or adjacent to a chute or chimney

evidence.source_text: 5. Fireline will not lie in or adjacent to a chute or chimney.

nodes.text: Anchor starting point for crew(s) building fireline down from the top

evidence.source_text: 6. Starting point will be anchored for crew(s) building fireline down from the top.

nodes.text: Monitor bottom of fire; if potential exists for the fire to spread, take action to secure the fire edge
